steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Ah! Ahhhhh... Ah!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Labyrinth, stop!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I am Hecate! I am on your side!
Labyrinth turns her entire body into a weapon, attacking everything in front of her.
Paintings, monsters, and people.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I won't let anyone near you again... ever...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I will clean up... Clean up all evil people in this world!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She can't hear me. I need to stop her first.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare, attack from the front and upset her balance.
The dark Nightmare dashes forward, intending to knock Labyrinth off her feet.
Thud!
The plan doesn't work. Labyrinth's power has surged with the overload mode, and she blocks the Nightmare.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Another filthy creature... time to clean up...
The blades on her arms are incredibly sharp, and she makes several attacks on the Nightmare within seconds.
And the Nightmare can barely keep up with her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare, get back here!
The situation takes a direct turn for the worse. Hecate can only order the Nightmare to retreat and wait for the next opportunity to attack.
After all, Labyrinth sees everything in sight as her enemies, not just Hecate.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Is... Is there something wrong with her?

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: And there are more monsters here...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's time for you to leave. This fight is only for Sinners.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: No... No! If I leave now, all I've done before will be in vain!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You will die.
Sasha clings to her equipment and tries to calm herself down. But from her whitening knuckles, it's clear that she's approaching her limit.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: No... No... I want to be popular, I want followers! I want people to watch my videos, and now is the best chance! I can't go now, I can't!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: You're... You're a Sinner... You will protect me, right?!
Sasha trembles, and the strange painting is pulling her in little by little.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Something is... pulling me...

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Help me... Help...!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No, Nightmare, pull her back!
The Nightmare rushes toward Sasha with all its strength.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Ahhh...
Sasha reaches out, but she's pulled into the painting the next second, leaving a long wail. The Nightmare isn't fast enough.
As if having gulped down a delicious offering, it gets louder in the museum, and the Corruptors seem more agitated.
Hecate looks around. She finally realizes why so many visitors are missing.
What shocks her even more is how many people have been turned into paintings because of their fear.
But she doesn't have time to dwell on the shocking realization. Labyrinth is what she should be worried about.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What... should I do... ${PlayerName}, how do I stop a robot?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This looks like... a malfunctioning program... but I have no experience repairing robots.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If only... Chief were here...

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Is this really a malfunctioning program?

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Only humans can have such pure and strong feelings.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She is... human. She's a... Sinner.
